svg.title: joflux - no lost repos, every stage on record
svg.desc: A migration run: repositories leave a cluster of GitHub nodes, pass through five stage gates (export, migrate, monitor, verify, archive) that each write to a state.json checkpoint, and land in a cluster of Forgejo slots while the originals are archived.

text.tspan: Five stages from a GitHub org to Forgejo or Codeberg,
each one writing JSON you keep. archive waits for you.
